definitions.explanation: Thick cubes of pork belly simmered slowly in soy sauce, sugar and sake until very tender.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{角煮|かくに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made braised pork belly at the weekend.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{角煮|かくに}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかい→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧。
examples.english: The braised pork at this restaurant is very tender.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長崎|ながさき}→長崎：30731_nagasaki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{角煮|かくに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{蒸|む}した→蒸す：02307_musu⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{挟|はさ}んだ→挟む：00091_hasamu⟧{角煮|かくに}まんが⟦{名物|めいぶつ}→名物：05591_meibutsu⟧だ。
examples.english: In Nagasaki, kakuni buns, braised pork tucked into steamed bread, are a local specialty.

notes:
Usually means pork (⟦{豚|ぶた}→豚：04710_buta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{角煮|かくに}), though tuna and other fish can be cooked the same way ({鮪|まぐろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{角煮|かくに}). Associated with Nagasaki; Okinawa's version is called ラフテー.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{豚|ぶた}→豚：04710_buta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{角煮|かくに}: braised pork belly
- {角煮|かくに}{丼|どん}: rice bowl topped with braised pork
- {角煮|かくに}まん: steamed bun filled with braised pork
